title: Focus Lens
summary: Keep your place in dense web apps with visible focus, reading lanes, zoom presets, and named waypoints.
user: Knowledge workers with low vision who use browser-heavy enterprise apps.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension with a large high-contrast focus indicator, temporary reading lane, per-site zoom and contrast presets, named focus waypoints, and an exportable shortcut cheat sheet.
constraints: Do not claim benefit before testing with low-vision users.
